# Detailed LLM Specification — Ahlul Firdaus (Product Strategy & Web Development)

## Overview
Ahlul Firdaus is a Founder, Product Strategist, UI/UX Designer & AI-Assisted Full-Stack Web Developer based in Batam, Indonesia. With over 20 years of background in manufacturing, quality assurance, and operations, he designs and develops digital product concepts, community information portals, high-density SaaS management dashboards, and public information hubs.

---

## Detailed Project Case Studies

### 1. Origin Of Indonesia (OOI)
- **Classification**: Founder-Led Product — Active Prototype
- **Role**: Founder, Product Strategist, UI/UX Designer & AI-Assisted Web Developer
- **Duration**: Ongoing Since 2026
- **Overview**: A founder-led B2B export platform concept designed to present premium Indonesian origin products to international importers, distributors, hospitality groups, and wholesale buyers.
- **Current Scope**: Focuses on premium product presentation, origin storytelling, export-oriented information architecture, buyer inquiry journeys, and a conceptual export trade simulator.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Netlify, GitHub.

### 2. CGV10 Portal Warga
- **Classification**: Community Portal — In Development
- **Role**: Product Strategist, UI/UX Designer & AI-Assisted Full-Stack Developer
- **Duration**: Ongoing Since 2026
- **Overview**: A community information portal designed for residents of Cipta Greenville RT 010/RW 021, consolidating announcements, committee directories, financial summaries, and PALUGADA resident marketplace.
- **Current Scope**: Centralized digital reference for community information with a mobile-first design and a proposed future visitor pass prototype.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Vercel.

### 3. Masjid Al Ikhlas Digital Presence
- **Classification**: Live Community Project
- **Role**: Digital Experience Strategist, UI/UX Designer & AI-Assisted Front-End Developer
- **Duration**: Ongoing Community Project
- **Overview**: A responsive public information website for Masjid Al Ikhlas Cipta Greenville, making prayer schedules, mosque programs, community updates, donation guides, and published financial reports accessible.
- **Tech Stack**: HTML5, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, SVG Design Assets, Netlify.

### 4. OneEcos Operational SaaS Cockpit
- **Classification**: Proof of Concept / Dashboard System
- **Role**: UI/UX Designer & Front-End Developer
- **Overview**: High-density operational management dashboard exploring multi-warehouse monitoring and telemetry data visualization.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, Recharts, Tailwind CSS.
